portInfo.description: North-coast Jamaica call. Treat waterfall/adventure products as booked excursions until ticket primaries are on file.
portInfo.currency: Jamaican Dollar (JMD), US Dollar widely accepted

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Port of Ocho Rios — Turtle Beach Road, Ocho Rios, St. Ann, Jamaica
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Transfer metres to town attractions gap on PAJ cruise page. Confirm day-of pier assignment with the line.
gettingThere.publicTransport: Confirm local transport options with the ship on your call date.
gettingThere.distanceAnswer: Transfer metres to town attractions gap on PAJ cruise page. Confirm day-of pier assignment with the line.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Town / craft-market stroll — only if your pier placement and programme allow (confirm with the line)
Booked waterfall or north-coast landscape excursion (Dunn’s River only via organised transfer — not a gangway walk)
Beach time — confirm operator, access, and transport with your line or excursion desk
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Do not assume Dunn’s River (or any named falls) is walkable from the gangway without a current transfer primary.

facts.significance: North-coast Jamaica cruise call under Port Authority of Jamaica

politics.visaRequirements: Many visitors on cruise calls use special cruise-passenger rules — confirm passport validity, PICA requirements, and any online declarations (e.g. C5) with your cruise line and official sources for your nationality.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport. Cruise transit formalities can differ from airport entry — follow your ship’s document list.
